requirement.statement: Every multi-turn AI actor SHALL participate in provider-context budgeting through an actor-owned generic context policy independent of actor role, agent type, tool name or product name, while Conversation and History authorities remain unchanged.

case.given: A delegate or detached actor is configured for multiple provider turns
case.when: Its materialized provider context approaches the configured budget
case.then: The executor SHALL apply the same generic compaction and resource-delivery mechanisms used by other multi-turn actors

case.given: An actor is explicitly configured as a one-tool short-lived execution
case.then: The actor MAY disable history compaction through the generic actor contract rather than an agent-name special case

case.given: AI Workflow actors exercise context budgeting
case.when: The runtime source and facts are inspected
case.then: They SHALL reuse Conversation materialization, ContextCompressor and generic delivery facts
The system MUST NOT create a workflow-specific history, compactor, cache or tool-name branch

case.given: A large tool result has not yet completed its first successful provider delivery
case.when: A delegate context budget is applied
case.then: The existing pending-first-delivery protection SHALL remain effective
